weather.note: 今天（9/4 週五）台北高溫約 27–28°C、低溫 25°C 上下，是這週最「濕」的一天。　台灣仍在低壓帶環境裡，加上偏北風增強，北部與宜蘭整天都有短暫陣雨、局部大雨的機率，而且屬於「短延時強降雨」——不是整天下不停，而是某一段時間突然很大。　沙德爾今天預計加速通過浙江海面並登陸中國，之後強度減弱、暴風圈縮小，對台灣沒有直接風災威脅，留下來的是水氣。　氣象署 9/3 已對含台北在內的 13 縣市發布大雨特報，今天延續同一套劇本。　實務建議：傘一定要帶（折傘不夠，最好長傘），鞋子挑防水的；如果今天有需要騎車跨區的行程，把時間往前挪，午後到傍晚是最容易被雨堵住的時段。　週末雨勢才會逐漸收斂，週日比較有機會放晴。

items.kind: 需要動作：評估要不要修——這是本週信件裡跟你科系最相關的一封
items.detail: 聯亞光電與成大合開矽光子學程，內容涵蓋 III-V 化合物半導體、InP 磊晶技術（epitaxy）與 CPO（Co-Packaged Optics，共同封裝光學），鎖定 800G 到 1.6T 高速傳輸。　三大亮點：產業接地氣（企業參訪、實習與專題合作）、取得學程證書享聯亞光電優先面談機會、以及 25 萬元相關獎助。　為什麼值得認真看：矽光子的核心其實有一大塊是材料與製程——磊晶、化合物半導體、封裝界面，這些是化工／材料背景的人反而比純電機背景更好切入的地方。　而且 CPO 正是今年 AI 資料中心最熱的題目之一（今天股市區塊裡博通、南電的故事都跟這條線有關），學程證書加優先面談是很實際的入場券。　建議動作：找出學程的完整課表與必修門檻，看跟你系上必修的衝堂情況，這週內決定。

items.en: Iran Fires Missiles at U.S. Bases as Tehran Accuses Washington of a War Crime Over Strike on Wedding
items.zh: 伊朗飛彈攻擊美軍基地，德黑蘭指控美方轟炸婚禮現場構成戰爭罪
items.summary: Iran launched missiles at American bases in the Middle East, with Jordan reporting it destroyed 10 of 13 incoming Iranian missiles on Wednesday. An Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman accused the United States of committing a war crime after a strike hit a wedding celebration, killing four people including two women and two children and wounding more than 60. President Trump has said publicly he does not expect the fighting to last long, but oil markets are not pricing that view: crude has now risen for four straight sessions, with WTI above 91 dollars and Brent above 95, as traders weigh the risk to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.en: European and NATO Officials Say Evidence Points to Russia Behind Foiled Attack on Leipzig/Halle Airport
items.zh: 歐洲與北約官員：證據顯示俄羅斯策動德國萊比錫／哈勒機場未遂攻擊
items.summary: Senior European and NATO officials said evidence indicates Russia launched a foiled attack against Leipzig/Halle airport in Germany, a logistics hub used to move aid and materiel eastwards. The incident lands in an already tense period for European air infrastructure and is being read in Brussels as part of a broader pattern of sabotage and hybrid operations rather than an isolated event. Officials have so far stopped short of formally invoking collective defence provisions, but the attribution raises pressure for a coordinated response and for tighter security at civilian airports that double as military logistics nodes.

items.en: U.N. Chief Warns the World Has Entered a Danger Zone of Extreme Weather as El Nino Strengthens
items.zh: 聯合國秘書長警告世界已進入「極端天氣危險區」，聖嬰現象恐為 70 年來最強
items.summary: U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned that the world has entered what he called a danger zone of extreme weather, pointing to data suggesting the current El Nino could be the strongest in more than seventy years and could persist until at least February 2027. A long, powerful El Nino reshapes rainfall and temperature patterns across the Pacific and beyond, typically bringing drought to parts of Asia and Australia and heavier rain to parts of the Americas. The warning matters for East Asia specifically because it changes the baseline expectation for typhoon behaviour and rainfall intensity for more than a year ahead.

items.en: More Than 900 People Killed in Israeli Attacks in Gaza This Year Despite the Ceasefire, Health Ministry Says
items.zh: 加薩衛生部：儘管停火，今年以色列攻擊已造成逾 900 人死亡
items.summary: Gaza's Ministry of Health said more than 900 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in the enclave this year, despite a ceasefire that is formally still in place. The figure underscores how partial and fragile the current arrangement is, with strikes continuing under contested interpretations of what the ceasefire permits. Aid agencies say access remains inconsistent and that reconstruction has barely begun in the worst-hit areas. The number is being cited by mediators as evidence that the agreement needs a stronger monitoring mechanism rather than another round of declaratory commitments.

items.en: Xi Jinping Visits Egypt for the First Time in a Decade as U.S. Influence Is Strained by the Iran War
items.zh: 習近平睽違十年訪問埃及，趁美國因伊朗戰爭分身乏術擴大中東布局
items.summary: China's President Xi Jinping travelled to Egypt for the first time in ten years, a visit analysts read as an illustration of Beijing's growing ambitions in a region where American influence has been strained by the war with Iran. Egypt sits at the junction of Red Sea shipping, Gulf capital and African infrastructure lending, all areas where China has been steadily expanding. The trip is being framed in Cairo around investment and industrial cooperation rather than security, but the timing, in the middle of an active U.S.-Iran conflict, is the part being noticed in Washington.

items.en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra and Calls It the Start of AGI; First Model to Hit Its Critical Cyber Threshold
items.zh: OpenAI 發表 GPT-6 Astra，稱之為 AGI 起點，也是首個觸及「關鍵」資安門檻的模型
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on Thursday, with president Greg Brockman calling it a generational leap that could eventually be seen as the arrival of artificial general intelligence. OpenAI says Astra is state of the art on computer use, browser use, software engineering, cybersecurity, science and professional work, and demonstrated it filling out spreadsheets and building websites from scratch without step-by-step guidance. It is also the first model OpenAI has designated as reaching the critical cybersecurity threshold in its preparedness framework, meaning it can find and exploit unknown vulnerabilities in well-protected systems, so advanced cyber capabilities are gated to a limited tester group.

items.en: ChatGPT, Claude and Grok Go Down Together as Azure East US Fails; Gemini Stays Up on Google Cloud
items.zh: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 同時斷線：Azure 美東區故障，只有跑在 Google Cloud 的 Gemini 存活
items.summary: Tens of thousands of users reported problems on Thursday as ChatGPT, Claude and Grok all degraded at the same time, with more than 37,000 outage reports filed for ChatGPT by around 11 a.m. Eastern. OpenAI detected elevated error rates across ChatGPT and Codex at roughly 10:58 UTC, affecting fifteen ChatGPT components and four on Codex, and applied mitigations within about 24 minutes. Anthropic's status page reported elevated errors across multiple models and a partial outage covering Claude.ai, the API, Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Reporting traced the common cause to an Azure East US failure; Gemini, on Google Cloud, saw only a small complaint spike.

items.en: Nvidia to Acquire Hugging Face for 12.93 Billion Dollars, Buying the Distribution Layer of Open-Source AI
items.zh: 輝達以 129.3 億美元收購 Hugging Face，把開源 AI 的「發行通路」買下來
items.summary: Nvidia confirmed it will acquire the open-source AI platform Hugging Face for 12.93 billion dollars, plus up to 1 billion in employee retention bonuses, with the deal expected to close in the first half of 2027. Hugging Face has roughly 18 million developers and 200,000 corporate users, and Jensen Huang said it will remain an open, multi-cloud platform independent of Nvidia hardware. The strategic logic is that Nvidia already owns the compute layer and is now buying the place where models are published and discovered. Nvidia shares rose about 1.5 percent on the news to close near 227.7 dollars.

items.en: US Open Day 5: Alcaraz and Shelton Battle Through, Tiafoe and Medvedev Advance to the Third Round
items.zh: 美網第 5 日：艾卡拉茲與謝爾頓苦戰過關，提亞福與麥維德夫晉級第三輪
items.summary: Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz recovered from an early setback to reach the third round at Flushing Meadows on Thursday, while Ben Shelton came through a hard-fought win over Hubert Hurkacz. Frances Tiafoe advanced in straight sets and Daniil Medvedev also moved into the third round. The men's draw is setting up a possible Alcaraz-Shelton quarter-final, which would be the tie of the round given how each has been serving through the first week. Play continues on the main show courts, with the quarter-finals not scheduled to begin until September 8.

items.en: Women's Draw Sets Up a Gauff-Anisimova Meeting and a Sabalenka-Noskova Quarter-Final Path
items.zh: 女單籤表成形：高芙可能對上阿尼西莫娃，莎芭蓮卡八強路徑指向諾斯科娃
items.summary: On the women's side the projected quarter-finals have Coco Gauff facing either Mirra Andreeva or Amanda Anisimova, and world number one Aryna Sabalenka lined up against Linda Noskova. Elena Rybakina and Jessica Pegula are the other seeds still expected to go deep. The quarter-finals begin September 8, so there is a full weekend of third and fourth round matches before those projections are tested. Serena and Venus Williams are also in the draw as a wild card doubles pairing, which has been drawing some of the largest crowds of the early sessions.

items.en: Super Bowl Champion Seahawks Will Open the 2026 NFL Season on a Wednesday Night, September 9
items.zh: 超級盃冠軍海鷹隊將在 9 月 9 日週三夜揭開 2026 NFL 球季序幕
items.summary: The Seattle Seahawks, the reigning Super Bowl champions, will open the 2026 NFL season on Wednesday night, September 9, an unusual midweek slot for the league's kickoff game. The scheduling shift is being read as an experiment in avoiding a crowded Thursday sports calendar and giving the opener its own window. For viewers in Asia the Wednesday night start in the United States means a Thursday morning kickoff in local time, which is considerably more watchable than the usual Friday morning slot.

items.en: Screen Time at Ages 1 and 6 Linked to Lasting Effects on Learning and Working Memory
items.zh: 1 歲與 6 歲的螢幕時間，對後續學習與工作記憶有長期影響
items.summary: A large longitudinal study found that screen viewing at ages 2 and 3 was not significantly associated with later academic outcomes, but the association reappeared at age 6, the point at which children enter formal education and face rising demands on attention, memory and learning. Researchers frame the finding as supporting a less-is-better principle rather than a hard threshold: one extra hour a day may produce no visible effect in an individual child, but small shifts across a whole population can move a meaningful number of children toward poorer academic outcomes. The age-six sensitivity is what educators are being told to focus on.

items.en: Eight-Year Finnish Study Finds Teenagers With More Screen Time Showed Better Cognitive Processing
items.zh: 芬蘭 8 年追蹤研究：螢幕時間較多的青少年，認知處理反而較佳
items.summary: An eight-year Finnish cohort study that tracked children into adolescence found that those who spent more time on screens tended to show better cognitive processing as teenagers, a result that runs against the dominant public narrative. The authors caution that the finding does not license unlimited use; it suggests that what is on the screen, and what it displaces, matter more than raw hours. Read alongside the age-six study above, the honest summary is that screen time is a poor single variable, and that content type, timing and the activity being replaced explain far more of the variance than duration alone.

items.en: For University Students, Academic Screen Use Predicts Better Exam Results While Recreational Use Predicts Worse
items.zh: 大學生研究：課業用途的螢幕時間與考試成績正相關，娛樂用途則相反
items.summary: Research on university cohorts reports a clean split: academic screen use is associated with better exam performance, while recreational screen use is associated with poorer outcomes, worse sleep quality and higher psychological distress. The practical implication for students is that total screen-time targets are close to useless as a self-management tool, and that separating the two categories is what actually predicts results. Context from the Healthy Minds Study is sobering: 37 percent of students reported moderate to severe depressive symptoms, nearly a third reported moderate to severe anxiety, and one in four felt isolated from others.

items.en: SEEQC Signs an MOU With Taiwan's Quantum Industry Technology Promotion Office at SEMICON Taiwan 2026
items.zh: SEEQC 於 SEMICON Taiwan 2026 與台灣量子產業技術推動辦公室簽署合作備忘錄
items.summary: SEEQC, a chip-based quantum computing company, announced on September 3 that it had signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Taiwan's Quantum Industry Technology Promotion Office to expand cooperation across quantum technology and the emerging global quantum supply chain. The MOU was signed during SEMICON Taiwan 2026. SEEQC's approach is to build classical control electronics directly onto the same chip stack as the qubits, which is a packaging and process problem as much as a physics one, and that is precisely where Taiwan's existing semiconductor supply chain has leverage.

items.en: IBM Tells a Chip Audience at SEMICON Taiwan That Quantum's Bottleneck Is Now Manufacturing, Not Physics
items.zh: IBM 在 SEMICON Taiwan 對晶片業者說：量子電腦的瓶頸已從物理轉為製造
items.summary: Speaking to a semiconductor audience at SEMICON Taiwan, IBM argued that the binding constraint on quantum computing has shifted from physics to manufacturing. The claim is that the remaining hard problems are yield, packaging, cryogenic interconnect and reproducibility at volume, which are exactly the disciplines the chip industry has spent decades industrialising. If that framing holds it changes who the relevant players are: quantum stops being a pure research race between labs and becomes a supply chain question in which foundries, packaging houses and materials suppliers hold real bargaining power.

items.en: IonQ, Nvidia and qBraid Report a 54 Percent Cut in Logical Error Rates Using Application-Native Mitigation
items.zh: IonQ、輝達與 qBraid 合作：應用原生誤差緩解框架讓邏輯錯誤率降低 54%
items.summary: IonQ, Nvidia and qBraid published research on September 1 demonstrating a 54 percent reduction in logical error rates for quantum simulations, using an application-native error mitigation framework running on IonQ's trapped-ion hardware together with Nvidia's GPU-accelerated computing. Error rates are the whole game in near-term quantum: without correction or mitigation, circuit depth is capped so low that nothing commercially interesting fits. Separately, IonQ agreed in January to acquire SkyWater Technology for roughly 1.8 billion dollars in cash and stock, a move that reads as buying domestic fabrication capacity.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour Confirms Kaohsiung National Stadium for October 31; Hong Kong Date Dropped
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 確定 10/31 高雄國家體育場，香港場取消、改加首爾 2027/1/9
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour has a confirmed Taiwan date: October 31, 2026 at Kaohsiung National Stadium, promoted locally by KKLIVE Taiwan. The Hong Kong leg has been removed from the world tour schedule, with a January 9, 2027 Seoul date added in its place. Kaohsiung National Stadium is the largest outdoor venue on the island at roughly 55,000 capacity, so this is a full stadium show rather than an arena date. For anyone based in Tainan this is the single most accessible major J-pop stadium show of the year, about an hour away by rail.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Set Their Sixth Album for September 30 and Launch the Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS the Same Day
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯 9/30 發行，同日啟動睽違三年的 Ringo Jam Tour「SHADOWS」
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on September 30, their first original album in three years since ANTENNA. The Mrs. GREEN APPLE Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS launches the same day at Anabuki Arena Kagawa and runs through December across Japanese arenas, their first arena run in three years. No Taiwan or Hong Kong date has been announced. Practical note: album release day and tour opening day being identical means the setlist will be built around unfamiliar material from night one, which historically pushes ticket demand toward the later dates.

items.en: LiSA's ASiA TOUR 2026 LiVE is Smile Always ~15~ Covers Taipei, Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur and Seoul
items.zh: LiSA ASiA TOUR 2026「LiVE is Smile Always ～15～」巡迴含台北、香港、吉隆坡、首爾
items.summary: LiSA's ASiA TOUR 2026, staged under the LiVE is Smile Always ~15~ banner marking fifteen years, runs from June through August across Kuala Lumpur, Taipei, Hong Kong and Seoul. The Taipei stop is the relevant one for anyone based in Taiwan; historically her Taipei shows have been arena-scale and have sold through general sale quickly. The fifteenth-anniversary framing usually means a career-spanning setlist rather than a single-album tour, which for LiSA covers the full anime tie-in catalogue and not just the recent records.

items.en: YOASOBI Add a Ten-City Asia Tour Spanning 2026-27 on Top of the North American Never Ending Stories Run
items.zh: YOASOBI 在北美「Never Ending Stories」巡演之外，再加開橫跨 2026–27 的十城亞洲巡迴
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced a ten-city Asia tour spanning 2026 into 2027, on top of the North American Never Ending Stories headline run powered by Crunchyroll that took in TD Garden in Boston, Barclays Center in Brooklyn and the Hollywood Bowl, plus festival slots at Lollapalooza and OSHEAGA. Their fourth English-language EP E-SIDE 4 collects UNDEAD, Watch me! and New me alongside a new English version of HEART BEAT. Taiwan and Hong Kong have featured on every previous YOASOBI Asia routing, so both are plausible on the ten-city list once venues are confirmed.

items.en: King Gnu Get a 22-Page Feature in ROCKIN'ON JAPAN's September Issue Covering the Tour and New Music
items.zh: King Gnu 登上《ROCKIN'ON JAPAN》九月號 22 頁特輯，談巡演與新作
items.summary: The September 2026 issue of ROCKIN'ON JAPAN carries a 22-page King Gnu feature covering the current tour and new music, alongside a special cover interview with YOASOBI's ikura and Ayase on their seven-year run, and a full documentary piece on Mrs. GREEN APPLE's stadium tour. Magazine features of this length in ROCKIN'ON are usually timed to precede an announcement rather than follow one, so the useful read is that new King Gnu material is close. Their previously announced Shanghai dates were cancelled, which leaves the Asia routing unsettled for now.

market.asOf: 台股 2026/09/03（週四）收盤 · 美股 2026/09/03（週四）收盤 —— 今天 9/4（五）台股 09:00 開盤、美股台北時間今晚 21:30 開盤；黃金、原油、比特幣與 10 年期公債殖利率為 9/3 盤中至收盤附近報價
market.note: ★ 9/3 是「台美完全走反方向」的一天，而且兩邊的理由都很清楚。　【美股 9/3】Fed 理事 Waller 表示，只要接下來的通膨數據沒有意外，他傾向支持「維持利率不變」。這句話直接把 9 月升息的機率從 63.2% 打到 50.4%（CME FedWatch），10 年期公債殖利率從前一天的 2023 年 11 月以來新高回落到 4.75%。　殖利率一降，高評價成長股立刻被重新定價：道瓊 +616.80 點（+1.16%，盤中一度 +635 點，是 8/4 以來最強）、S&P 500 +0.99%、Nasdaq +1.31%。日圓兩天升值近 3%（來到 155.36）也順帶壓低了美債殖利率。　個股層面：Snowflake +20.77% 是全場焦點，Dell +15.8%、Robinhood +15.08%、Tesla +7.03%；反方向的是 Broadcom -3.48%——它的 Q3 其實有超預期（EPS 3.32 美元、營收 296 億美元，AI 半導體營收 167 億美元、年增 221%），但營收只贏市場共識 0.53%、EPS 只贏 2.53%，加上第四季財測低於預期，在「AI 交易已經定價到滿」的環境下，小贏等於輸。　【台股 9/3】完全相反的劇本：開高 46,325.48、盤中衝到 46,517.45，但尾盤最後半小時遭遇賣壓急殺翻黑，終場 45,857.66（-307.06、-0.67%），失守 46K，全日震盪 678 點，成交值放大到 9,462.71 億元——價跌量增，代表這不是單純的獲利了結。　三大法人合計賣超 637.11 億元（外資及陸資賣超 481.46 億、自營商賣超 167.07 億、投信買超 11.42 億）。　盤面結構是「二線電子被甩、資金逃進金融」：南電跌停、南亞科 -7.82%、南亞 -6.95%、華邦電 -5.59%、國巨 -5.37%、緯穎 -5.17%、欣興 -5.14%；同時玉山金 +6.67%、國泰金 +3.21%、富邦金 +2.44%。權值三雄台積電 +0.21%、聯發科 +1.52%、台達電 +1.73% 逆勢守住，才讓指數沒有跌更多。
market.highlight: 🔭 今天（9/4 週五）到下週要盯的三件事：　① 【今晚的 8 月非農就業，是這一切的收斂點】9/3 美股整場的漲勢，本質上是押注「Fed 9/15–16 會議不升息」。這個押注今晚就要面對第一份硬數據——8 月非農。線索是 9/2 的 ADP 民間就業只增加 3.8 萬人，遠低於預期。如果非農同樣疲弱，Waller 的說法被驗證，這波漲勢有續航力；如果非農強勁，昨天的 50.4% 會迅速跳回去，殖利率再彈，高評價成長股（Tesla、Snowflake 這類）會是第一批被打的。　② 【載板與 PCB 族群的重新定價還沒結束】南電跌停的兩個原因裡，「博通 2027 財年自建新加坡載板產能」是結構性的，不是一天的消息。這條線會持續影響南電、欣興、景碩、台光電、金像電的評價。對你來說這也是矽光子學程那封信的現實背景——CPO 與高速載板是同一個戰場。　③ 【台美背離要收斂】9/3 Dell 在美股 +15.8%，同日台股緯穎 -5.17%，這種背離通常不會維持太久。今天台股開盤要看的是：緯創、廣達、英業達、緯穎會不會補漲；如果不補，代表市場真的認為台廠 ODM 只是代工毛利，而不是 AI 需求的受惠者——那是比單日漲跌更重要的訊號。

movers.name: Dell Technologies
movers.reason: ★★ 清單外新標的 · 財報大幅超預期，9/3 跳漲 15.8%。　Dell 是 AI 伺服器的整機出海口，它跳這麼多，對台股的訊號比對美股還大——緯創、廣達、英業達、緯穎都在同一條 ODM 與整機供應鏈上。　但值得注意的是同一天台股緯穎反而跌 5.17%，兩邊訊號矛盾，代表市場在區分「整機出貨」與「零組件毛利」是兩回事。

movers.name: 南亞電路板
movers.reason: ★★ 清單外新標的（今天最該看的一檔）· 爆量跌停，兩個原因疊加：① 公司第四季載板暫無漲價計畫，打破市場對「ABF／BT 載板量價齊揚」的期待；② 大客戶博通（Broadcom）在法說會確認 2027 財年將啟用自家新加坡載板產能（已投資日本 TOPPAN 在新加坡蓋廠），市場擔心南電未來在供應商位階被下修。　這件事同時解釋了為什麼 9/3 欣興 -5.14%、景碩與富喬 -8%——整個載板族群被同一則消息重新定價。

movers.reason: ★ 清單內（加密與區塊鏈）· 分析師調升評等帶動大漲 15%。　Robinhood 的營收結構高度綁定散戶交易量與加密現貨，9/3 比特幣同步走強（約 +4.9% 至 8 萬美元附近），兩者互相加乘。　提醒：這種靠評等調升的單日大漲，回吐機率不低。

movers.name: GitLab
movers.reason: ★ 清單外 · 連續第二天出現在這張表：9/2 盤前一度 +21%，9/3 再漲約 10%。　題材是「AI 寫的程式碼比例上升，版本控管、CI 與權限審核平台就更重要」，這條敘事今天被 GPT-6 Astra 的發表進一步強化（Astra 主打自主軟體工程能力）。

movers.name: Tesla
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（電動車）· 單日 +7.03%、+25.08 美元，是 9/3 大型權值股裡漲最兇的一檔，直接把 Nasdaq 往上推。　當天沒有單一重大公司新聞，比較合理的解釋是 Fed 官員鴿派發言 → 10 年期公債殖利率回落至 4.75% → 高評價成長股集體被重新定價，Tesla 是這條線上 beta 最高的標的。

movers.name: 玉山金
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（金融防禦）· 9/3 台股最大特色就是「資金從二線電子逃到金融」，玉山金大漲 6.67% 是整個金融族群的領頭羊。　同日國泰金 +3.21%（突破 110 元）、富邦金 +2.44%（盤中一度創新高 148.5 元）、中信金 +1.35%，兆豐金、元大金、台新新光金也都漲逾 2%。　法人給的理由是明年股利可望創高加上法說行情與併購題材，但也有聲音提醒「金融最後一棒」的風險。

movers.name: SpaceX
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（太空與衛星）· +8.69 美元，跟著風險偏好回升走強。　這檔波動一向很大（清單標註風險『很高』），單日 6% 對它來說不算異常，不要因為一天的漲幅就改變部位判斷。

movers.name: 南亞科
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（記憶體）· 8 月營收再創新高，股價卻重挫 7.82%、盤中破 500 元大關最低殺到 490 元，單日蒸發 586 億元市值。　法人解讀是「營收月增不到 2%」引爆短線利多出盡；但同時提醒 10 月換約潮後報價可望上調，估第 4 季平均售價升幅上看 4 成。　這是典型的「基本面沒壞、預期太滿」型態。

movers.name: 華邦電
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（記憶體）· 跟著南亞科殺 5.59%、蒸發 277 億元。記憶體族群 9/3 全體臉綠，群聯跌 3% 力守 2,000 元，模組廠也全受累。

movers.name: 緯穎
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（AI 伺服器）· 跌 5.17%，是二線電子權值全面遭甩賣的一員。　對照同一天 Dell 在美股大漲 15.8%，這個背離值得記下來：市場正在把「AI 伺服器整機需求」和「台廠 ODM 毛利率」分開評價。

movers.name: 欣興
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（載板與 PCB）· 受南電跌停與博通自建新加坡載板產能的消息拖累，跌 5.14%。　背景提醒：欣興日前才因 PCB 產品涉嫌洗產地連 2 天重挫，法人普遍認為不影響核心競爭力、目標價仍在 1,300–1,500 元，但短線上兩個利空疊在一起。

movers.name: 華通
movers.reason: ★ 清單內（PCB 與衛星通訊）· 與楠梓電、晟鈦、榮科、柏承同列 9/3 跌幅逾 5% 的 PCB 重災區。　整個族群是被「載板不漲價加上大客戶自建產能」這一則消息一起打下來的，屬於題材面而非個別基本面。
